Impact of Extreme Weather Events on the U.S. Domestic Supply Chain of Food Manufacturing
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: In the United States, like in other countries, the agrifood supply chain faces challenges from a growing population and less predictable weather conditions. Extreme weather events such as droughts decrease agricultural yield and harvested areas, impact the domestic trade of agricultural products and, in turn, food manufacturing. We investigate this relationship at the state level by estimating the food manufacturing production function in a two-stage instrumental variable estimation process. We first assess how drought affects trade in animals and fish, cereal grains, and all other crop products. Next, we estimate a nested production function for processed food. Our findings indicate that the impact of a drought is far from being confined to the area where it happens. At the national level, we find that a 1% increase in drought in the states producing agricultural commodities reduces their exports to other states by 0.5% to 0.7% which, in turn, reduces food manufacturing production by an average of 0.04%. The capacity to shift the origin of import flows, adjust their volume, and substitute agricultural inputs supports the resilience of the food manufacturing sector. We further estimate the 48 × 48 pairwise dependence across states and by commodity group. While cereal grain production is more spatially concentrated than other crops, the agrifood supply chain can enhance its resilience by sourcing from geographically diverse counties within key supplier states and improving multistate coordination. These findings provide important insights for policymakers and industry stakeholders willing to reduce the food system vulnerability to extreme weather events.
abstract_zh: 在美国，与其他国家一样，农业食品供应链面临人口增长和天气状况更加难以预测所带来的挑战。干旱等极端天气事件会降低农业产量和收获面积，影响农产品的国内贸易，进而影响食品制造业。我们在州一级研究这一关系，通过两阶段工具变量估计法估计食品制造的生产函数。我们首先评估干旱如何影响动物和鱼类、谷物以及其他所有作物产品的贸易。随后，我们估计加工食品的嵌套生产函数。我们的研究发现，干旱的影响远不止局限于其发生地。在全国层面，我们发现，农产品生产州的干旱程度每增加1%，其对其他州的出口就减少0.5%至0.7%，进而使食品制造业产量平均减少0.04%。转换进口来源、调整进口量以及替代农业投入品的能力，支撑了食品制造部门的韧性。我们还按州和商品类别估计了48×48的两两依赖关系。谷物生产在空间上比其他作物更为集中，但农业食品供应链可以通过从主要供应州内地理上多元化的县采购，并加强多州协调，来提高其韧性。这些发现为希望降低食品系统对极端天气事件脆弱性的政策制定者和行业利益相关者提供了重要见解。

title: The Sensitivity of Rice Yields to Weather Variation in Colombia
venue: Banco de la República de Colombia Working Paper
abstract: We estimate the effects of annual temperature and precipitation on rice yields in Colombia from 1987 to 2016. The analysis explores the degree of variation in response to climate changes across the country’s diverse topography. Since there are two growing seasons in Colombia, the effects of the weather conditions for these two seasons are independently investigated. Additionally, rice yields are projected for two periods (2046-2065 and 2081-2100) based on the RCP 4.5, 6.5, and 8.0 of future climate scenarios. We found a positive effect of rainfall and temperature on yields, although one variable attenuates the effect of the other. The early season temperature and the later season precipitation were the main drivers of the yield. Effects were larger in departments with higher altitudes. Projections show that temperature and precipitation changes will cause rice yields to increase by 10% over 2046-2065, and 2081-2100, with respect to the reference period 1987-2016.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了1987至2016年间年均气温和降水对哥伦比亚水稻单产的影响。分析探讨了该国多样地形条件下，气候变化引起的响应程度差异。由于哥伦比亚有两个生长季，我们分别独立考察这两个季节的天气条件影响。此外，基于RCP 4.5、6.5和8.0等未来气候情景，我们对两个时期（2046–2065年和2081–2100年）的水稻单产进行了预测。我们发现降雨和气温对单产有正向影响，尽管其中一个变量会削弱另一个变量的效应。早季气温和晚季降水是单产的主要驱动因素。海拔较高的省份效应更大。预测显示，相对于1987–2016年的参照期，2046–2065年和2081–2100年间气温和降水的变化将使水稻单产提高10%。

title: Identifying the Key Atmospheric and Economic Drivers of Global Carbon Monoxide Emission Transfers
abstract: This paper proposes a structural decomposition analysis (SDA) augmented with cross-country atmospheric circulation and uncovers that changes in carbon monoxide (CO) levels are driven by atmospheric flows way more than by any of the traditional SDA components. Applied to a five-region model, our results show, among others, that South Korea has certainly been able to reduce the CO emissions in its own territory by 0.8Tg over 1990–2014 but up to 10.6Tg of CO flowing to its borders came from its upwind neighbor China. That amount was primarily driven by activities satisfying the growth of China's domestic demand, although changes in foreign demand and in the technology effect were not negligible. By quantifying the role of upwind countries in air pollution changes, our methodology allows us to identify more comprehensive global emission abatement policies than the consumer- or producer-focused approaches currently used.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种融入跨国大气环流的结构分解分析（SDA），发现一氧化碳（CO）水平的变化受大气流动的驱动远远超过任何传统SDA组成部分。应用于一个五区域模型，我们的结果表明，除其他外，韩国在1990–2014年间确实将其本国领土内的CO排放减少了0.8 Tg，但流向其边境的CO中，多达10.6 Tg来自其上风方向的邻国中国。这一数量主要由满足中国国内需求增长的活动所驱动，尽管外国需求变化和技术效应也不可忽视。通过量化上风国家在空气污染变化中的作用，我们的方法使我们能够识别比目前采用的以消费者或生产者为中心的方法更为全面的全球减排政策。

The Impact and Externalities of Extreme Natural Disasters on Local Tax Revenue in Colombia
abstract: This paper studies the impact of natural disasters on tax revenue across Colombian municipalities. We follow a two-step approach to evaluate how a municipality’s tax revenue depends on natural disasters taking place both locally and in its trade partners. In the first step, we estimate a gravity model of bilateral trade and construct a matrix of estimated bilateral trade shares, allowing us to measure the strength of the economic relationships between municipalities. In the second step, our results reveal that natural disasters in the destination municipalities increase the tax revenue in the origin cities.
abstract_zh: 本文研究自然灾害对哥伦比亚各市镇税收收入的影响。我们采用两步法，评估市镇税收收入如何取决于其本地及其贸易伙伴所在地发生的自然灾害。第一步，我们估计双边贸易的引力模型，并构建估计的双边贸易份额矩阵，从而衡量市镇之间经济联系的强度。第二步，我们的结果表明，目的地市镇发生的自然灾害会增加出发城市的税收收入。

The Natural Resource Curse: Evidence from the Colombian Municipalities
abstract: This paper evaluates the effect of natural resource revenue on expenditure efficiency. Using a panel of Colombian municipalities over 2003–2011, we use a two-step procedure to estimate the effect of natural resource revenue on municipal efficiency. First, the technical efficiency of local governments is calculated through a robust non-parametric method. These estimates are then used in a second step to evaluate how the local government's efficiency varies with exogenous variation in royalties. Our findings indicate that royalties reduce efficiency in the provision of education and health care services, providing evidence of one of the mechanisms explaining the natural resource curse.
abstract_zh: 本文评估自然资源收入对支出效率的影响。利用2003–2011年哥伦比亚市镇的面板数据，我们采用两步法估计自然资源收入对市镇效率的影响。第一步，通过稳健的非参数方法计算地方政府的技术效率。第二步，利用这些估计值评估地方政府效率如何随特许权使用费的外生变动而变化。我们的研究发现，特许权使用费降低了教育和医疗服务供给的效率，这为解释自然资源诅咒的机制之一提供了证据。

title: Understanding Heterogeneous Spatial Production Externalities as a Missing Link between Land Use Planning and Urban Economic Futures
abstract: Land-use planning influences economic performance as it can intervene with location-specific and heterogeneous production externalities. This paper examines the impacts of heterogeneous externalities on local employment growth using a panel model framework with block-level land-use data inventory for Chicago. Cross-industry spillovers provide positive impacts on growth, but the mechanisms behind them differ across sectors and spatial scales. Improved understanding of heterogeneity in agglomeration economies can better support plan-making and urban economic performance. The results show significant and positive influence of cross-industry spillovers, a missing consideration in existing planning processes.
abstract_zh: 土地利用规划会影响经济绩效，因为它可能干预具有地点特异性和异质性的生产外部性。本文利用芝加哥街区层面的土地利用数据清单，在面板模型框架下考察异质性外部性对地方就业增长的影响。跨行业溢出效应对增长有正向影响，但其背后的机制在不同部门和空间尺度上存在差异。更好地理解集聚经济的异质性，可以为规划制定和城市经济绩效提供更好的支持。结果显示，跨行业溢出效应具有显著的正向影响，而这一点是现有规划过程中所缺失的考虑因素。

title: Drivers of Water Use in the Agricultural Sector of the European Union 27
abstract: Population growth and the uncertain hazards that accompany climate change have put increasing pressure on the management and sustainability of water. It has a direct impact on agriculture and its domestic and international supply chain linkages. As one of the largest agricultural producers in the world, the European Union (EU) is particularly sensitive to changes in water availability. Therefore, we perform a structural decomposition analysis based on the recently released EXIOBASE 3 database to examine in depth how changes in water input coefficients, in final demand and in technology have affected changes in water use across crops. Crop production consumes 99% of the direct water in agriculture. Our results show that the largest EU crop producers have experienced an increase in water use that is mostly driven by changes in technology. On the other hand, several Mediterranean countries, where water scarcity has been a problem for years, have decreased their water consumption mostly thanks to an improvement in their water intensity. Results by crop are consistent with those at the aggregated level except for vegetables of which water use changes have been primarily driven by changes in final demand and water intensity.
abstract_zh: 人口增长以及伴随气候变化而来的不确定风险，对水资源管理和可持续性施加了日益增大的压力。这直接影响农业及其国内和国际供应链联系。作为全球最大的农产品生产者之一，欧盟（EU）对水资源可用性的变化尤为敏感。因此，我们基于最新发布的EXIOBASE 3数据库开展结构分解分析，深入考察投入系数、最终需求和技术的变化如何影响各作物的用水变化。作物生产消耗了农业直接用水的99%。我们的结果显示，欧盟最大的作物生产国的用水量有所增加，且这主要由技术变化所驱动。另一方面，若干地中海国家长期面临水资源短缺问题，其用水量有所下降，主要得益于水资源利用强度的改善。按作物分类的结果与总体水平的结果基本一致，但蔬菜除外，其用水变化主要由最终需求变化和用水强度变化所驱动。

title: Premium Misrating in Federal Crop Insurance: Scale, Geography, and Fiscal Impacts
abstract:
Purpose
Federal crop insurance programs are the primary risk management programs of the US farm programs. Currently, these programs have been criticized for being disproportionally in favor of the riskier areas. Despite previous researchers having widely speculated its existence, a formal study of the scale, spatial pattern and fiscal impacts of such misrating phenomenon is still missing in the literature.
Design/methodology/approach
This paper first purposes an empirically testable definition of misrating, and then detects the scale of the misrating phenomenon by using over two million actuarial records collected by United States Department of Agriculture (USDA's) risk management agency since 1989. Furthermore, multiple spatial statistics methods have been adopted to study the spatial patterns of the misrating statuses. Finally, the paper builds a simple theoretical model to study the potential fiscal impacts of any policy attempts to mitigate the misrating issue.
Findings
The result reveals that roughly 40% of the counties display some degree of misrating. Furthermore, the distribution of misrating displays a significant pattern of positive global spatial autocorrelation, which reflects the existence of regional clusters of premium rate mispricing. Last but not least, the paper concludes that whether an attempt toward fair rating decreases the total program outlay or not relies on the demand elasticity of crop insurance in both overrated and underrated regions.
Originality/value
This paper offers the first attempt to quantify the scale, identify the spatial pattern and evaluate the fiscal impact of the premium misrating in federal crop insurance programs.
abstract_zh:
目的
联邦农作物保险计划是美国农业计划中的主要风险管理项目。目前，这些计划因对风险较高地区的偏向而受到批评。尽管以往研究者普遍推测这种现象的存在，但文献中仍缺乏对这种保费错误定价现象的规模、空间格局和财政影响的正式研究。
设计/方法/途径
本文首先提出一个可进行实证检验的错误定价定义，然后利用美国农业部风险管理局自1989年以来收集的超过二百万条精算记录，检验错误定价现象的规模。此外，本文采用多种空间统计方法研究错误定价状态的空间格局。最后，本文构建了一个简单的理论模型，以研究任何旨在缓解错误定价问题的政策尝试的潜在财政影响。
研究发现
结果显示，约40%的县存在某种程度的错误定价。此外，错误定价的分布呈现出显著的全局正空间自相关格局，这反映了保费费率错误定价的区域性集群的存在。最后，本文得出结论：公平定价的尝试能否降低计划总支出，取决于农作物保险在被高估和被低估地区的需求弹性。
原创性/价值
本文首次尝试量化联邦农作物保险计划中保费错误定价的规模、识别其空间格局，并评估其财政影响。

title: What Factors Drive the Changes in Water Withdrawals in the U.S. Agriculture and Food Manufacturing Industries between 1995-2010?
abstract: Climate change and increasing world population will directly impact the global food supply chain linkages. In the United States, agricultural production requires less irrigated water than before but it still accounts for a third of total water withdrawals. To better understand the evolution of its water use, we perform a structural decomposition analysis of water withdrawals across eight different crops and six livestock categories and differentiate the trends over 1995-2005 vs 2005-2010 to account for the role of the economic crisis in the second period. Based on USGS data, the results show that both periods experienced an overall decline in water withdrawals in the production of all crops except oilseeds. This trend is driven by a decrease in water intensity, reflecting greater efficiency of irrigation systems, and by reduced local per capita income in the second period. However, increased foreign demand for water-intensive sectors like oilseeds from NAFTA and Asian partners mitigated the decline. Results indicate also a decreasing water use in livestock production partially due to a shift from red to white meat consumption in the country. Arguably, recent tariff wars and border closures have greatly reduced the virtual water embodied in American exports.
abstract_zh: 气候变化和世界人口增长将直接影响全球食品供应链联系。在美国，农业生产所需的灌溉水量比以前减少，但其仍占全国总取水量的三分之一。为更好地理解其用水演变，我们对八种作物和六类牲畜的取水量进行了结构分解分析，并区分了1995–2005年与2005–2010年两个时期的趋势，以考虑第二个时期经济危机的作用。基于美国地质调查局（USGS）的数据，结果显示，两个时期中，除油料作物外，所有作物生产的取水量总体均有所下降。这一趋势由用水强度下降（反映灌溉系统效率提高）以及第二时期人均收入下降所驱动。然而，来自北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）伙伴和亚洲伙伴对油料作物等耗水密集型产业的外国需求增加，减缓了这一下降。结果还表明，由于国内消费从红肉向白肉的转变，畜牧业用水也在减少。可以说，近期的关税战和边境关闭极大地减少了美国出口中所含的虚拟水。

title: Comparing the Economic Impact of Natural Disasters Generated by Different Input-output Models: An Application to the 2007 Chehalis River Flood (WA)
abstract: Due to the concentration of assets in disaster‐prone zones, changes in risk landscape and in the intensity of natural events, property losses have increased considerably in recent decades. While measuring these stock damages is common practice in the literature, the assessment of economic ripple effects due to business interruption is still limited and available estimates tend to vary significantly across models. This article focuses on the most popular single‐region input–output models for disaster impact evaluation. It starts with the traditional Leontief model and then compares its assumptions and results with more complex methodologies (rebalancing algorithms, the sequential interindustry model, the dynamic inoperability input–output model, and its inventory counterpart). While the estimated losses vary across models, all the figures are based on the same event, the 2007 Chehalis River flood that impacted three rural counties in Washington State. Given that the large majority of floods take place in rural areas, this article gives the practitioner a thorough review of how future events can be assessed and guidance on model selection.
abstract_zh: 由于资产集中于灾害易发地区，风险格局的变化以及自然事件强度的变化，近几十年来财产损失大幅增加。尽管测算这些存量损失在文献中已是常规做法，但对业务中断所引起的经济连锁效应的评估仍然有限，且现有估计在不同模型之间差异显著。本文聚焦于用于灾害影响评估的最流行的单区域投入产出模型。文章从传统的列昂惕夫（Leontief）模型出发，并将其假设与结果同更为复杂的方法（再平衡算法、顺序产业间模型、动态无效率投入产出模型及其存货对应模型）进行比较。尽管不同模型的损失估计各不相同，但所有数字均基于同一事件，即2007年切哈利斯河洪水，该洪水影响了华盛顿州的三个农村县。鉴于绝大多数洪水发生在农村地区，本文为从业者提供了对如何评估未来事件的全面回顾，并为模型选择提供指导。

Tracking an Atmospheric River in a Warmer Climate: From Water Vapor to Economic Impacts
abstract: Atmospheric rivers (ARs) account for more than 75 % of heavy precipitation events and nearly all of the extreme flooding events along the Olympic Mountains and western Cascade mountains of western Washington state. In a warmer climate, ARs in this region are projected to become more frequent and intense, primarily due to increases in atmospheric water vapor. However, it is unclear how the changes in water vapor transport will affect regional flooding and associated economic impacts. In this work, we present an integrated modeling system to quantify the atmospheric-hydrologic-hydraulic and economic impacts of the December 2007 AR event that impacted the Chehalis river basin in western Washington. We use the modeling system to project impacts under a hypothetical scenario where the same December 2007 event occurs in a warmer climate. This method allows us to incorporate different types of uncertainty including: a) alternative future radiative forcings, b) different responses of the climate system to future radiative forcings and c) different responses of the surface hydrologic system. In the warming scenario, AR integrated vapor transport increases, however, these changes do not translate into generalized increases in precipitation throughout the basin. The changes in precipitation translate into spatially heterogeneous changes in sub-basin runoff and increased streamflow along the entire Chehalis main stem. Economic losses due to stock damages increased moderately, but losses in terms of business interruption were significant. Our integrated modeling tool provides communities in the Chehalis region with a range of possible future physical and economic impacts associated with AR flooding.
abstract_zh: 大气河（ARs）占华盛顿州西部奥林匹克山脉和喀斯喀特山脉西麓强降水事件的75%以上，并且几乎所有极端洪水事件都与之有关。在气候变暖的情况下，预计该地区的大气河将变得更加频繁和强烈，这主要归因于大气水汽的增加。然而，水汽输送的变化将如何影响区域洪水及相关经济影响，目前尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个综合建模系统，用以量化2007年12月影响华盛顿州西部切哈利斯河流域的大气河事件所带来的大气-水文-水力及经济影响。我们利用该建模系统，模拟在气候变暖的假设情景下，2007年12月同一事件再次发生时的影响。这种方法使我们能够纳入不同类型的不确定性，包括：a）未来不同的辐射强迫；b）气候系统对未来辐射强迫的不同响应；c）地表水文系统的不同响应。在变暖情景下，大气河综合水汽输送增加，但这些变化并未转化为整个流域普遍增加的降水。降水变化转化为各子流域径流的空间异质性变化，并使切哈利斯干流沿线的河流流量增加。由库存损失造成的经济损失适度增加，但业务中断造成的损失十分显著。我们的综合建模工具为切哈利斯地区的社区提供了与大气河洪水相关的一系列可能的未来物理和经济影响。
